name: IIITS MFace Dataset
description: Face recognition in images is an active area of interest among the computer vision researchers. However, recognizing human face in an unconstrained environment, is a relatively less-explored area of research. Multiple face recognition in unconstrained environment is a challenging task, due to the variation of view-point, scale, pose, illumination and expression of the face images. Partial occlusion of faces makes the recognition task even more challenging. The contribution of this paper is two-folds: introducing a challenging multiface dataset (i.e., IIITS MFace Dataset) for face recognition in unconstrained environment and evaluating the performance of state-of-the-art hand-designed and deep learning based face descriptors on the dataset. reputation: A niche academic dataset for unconstrained multi-face recognition, mainly used for evaluating face descriptors under challenging conditions.
notes: Small, domain-specific vision dataset with challenging occlusion and pose variation; not a standard large-scale benchmark and likely sensitive to protocol choices.
